data.text:
Mohan Kumar vs Ut Of J&K on 8 July, 2024 
Author: Sindhu Sharma
Bench: Sindhu Sharma
 
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
 Crm(M) No.
 Mohan Kumar .... Petitione
 Through:- Mr. Varut Kumar Gupta, Advoc
 V/s
 Ut of J&K .....R 
 Through:- Mr. Amit Gupta, Aag. 
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Sindhu Sharma, Judge 
 Order 
08.07.2024 01. The petitioner seeks quashing of criminal proceedings in the complaint titled 'State of J&K vs.
Mohan Kumar and others', pending before the Court below under Section 26(2) (i) & (ii) read with Section 59(1) and Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The petitioner also seeks quashing of the order dated 26.09.2019, whereby the Court below issued process and summons against him. 
02. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that this complaint has already been assailed in CRM(M) No. 187/2023 and proceedings against the petitioners have been stayed.
03. Notice. 
04. Mr. Amit Gupta, learned AAG, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent. 
05. List along with CRM(M) No. 248/2023.
06. Meanwhile, subject to objections from the other side and till next date of hearing before the Bench, the proceedings pending before the authenticity of this document. 
Court of 2nd Additional Munsiff (Judicial Magistrate 1st Class) in complaint titled 'State of J&K vs.
